Reference 1 is the LOCKED headless mannequin pose atlas: preserve its joint positions, neck/collar opening, shoulder/hip heights, wrist and hand positions, knees, ankles, each lifted foot, exact stride, body proportions and feet baseline FRAME FOR FRAME. Reference 2 is the approved player illustration for organic cloth folds, outlines and soft shading. EXACT layout FOUR columns by FOUR rows, a portrait atlas about 1152x1728 (2:3); rows FRONT/down, RIGHT PROFILE, BACK/up, LEFT PROFILE; columns the corresponding FOUR distinct approved walk poses. Keep the large transparent upper headroom and each body in the LOWER half of its cell, at the exact source scale and location. NECK DOWN ONLY: no head, hair, face, ears, hat, bust portraits or extra characters. True transparent alpha, no ground, no shadows, no text, no grid, separate cells with generous transparent gutters. No 3D, vector-flat shapes, stiff stick figures or warped anatomy. No pose reinterpretation, no added limb, no torso resizing, no direction changes within a row. Preserve cream/white details and small brass buttons. Reproduce the exact body geometry of reference 1 rather than drawing a new body. FULL-BODY blue DENIM OVERALLS in medium key-blue #5086bf over a warm CREAM short-sleeve tee, brass overall buckles, bib pocket, connected trouser legs in the exact master stride. Tan bare forearms/hands. This is a FULL SUIT: overalls include their OWN trouser legs; don't add another waistband or jeans under them. Brown cream-soled SNEAKERS as fixed companions.
CORRECTION PASS: The earlier attempt made shoulders, forearms and hands too large and low compared with mannequin. Trace the mannequin outline and hand/finger contours precisely; each sleeve ends at the same elbow height and each hand occupies the same pixels as reference 1. Do not bulk up the figure. Keep the original narrower torso and smaller hands. Overalls must be fitted around this exact body. Keep cream sleeves, indigo blue bib and trousers, no dark naked hole painted in neck.
